# Money Talks News

> > Personal finance news, education, and television content helping consumers make smarter money decisions.

Money Talks News (MTN) provides financial advice through multiple channels including MTN Academy educational courses, MTN Television broadcast segments, and written content. The site features resources on retirement planning, debt management, and everyday money management strategies.

## Key Topics

- Personal finance
- Retirement planning
- Debt management
- Financial education
- Money management
- MTN Academy courses
- MTN Television broadcasts
- The Only Retirement Guide You'll Ever Need
- Money Made Simple
- Life or Debt
- Consumer finance advice
- Online financial courses
- News inserts
- Broadcast content

## Financial Education & Courses

- [MTN Academy](https://www.moneytalksnews.com/academy/): Financial education courses and books including retirement and debt guides

## Television & Media

- [MTN Television](https://scripts.moneytalksnews.com/): MTN Television news inserts and broadcast content by Money Talks News
